U6KDJdnwBzrqnJZbLUeMvg.zh: WHO於今年5/14召開第45次IHR小兒麻痺症緊急委員會並於8/25公布決議,今年截至4/30全球累積報告16例WPV1病例、2 例cVDPV1病例、28例cVDPV2病例及2例cVDPV3病例。環境樣本部分:累計報告74件WPV1、27件cVDPV2。考量全球疫情傳播及疫苗覆蓋率,評估持續構成國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC),並再延⻑臨時性措施3個月,惟不構成緊急大流行(Pandemic Emergency),並建議有11個國家(有WPV1、cVDPV1、cVDPV3傳播風險者)需加強疫情監測及疫苗接種等措施,包括有WPV1疫情之阿富汗、巴基斯坦、德國,有cVDPV1 疫情之阿爾及利亞、剛果⺠主共和國、吉布地、以色列、寮國,有cVDPV3疫情之喀麥隆、查德、奈及利亞;另建議24個有cVDPV2國內傳播風險的國家加強防治措施。由於核疫區的持續傳播、偏鄉與衝突地區疫苗接種覆蓋率不均以及頻繁的跨國人口流動,WPV1及cVDPV仍具有高度國際傳播風險 。 WHO於8/19宣布非洲5國cVDPV2疫情已終止,分別為蒲隆地 、迦納、幾內亞比索、剛果共和國及烏干達。當局近年透過資金與技術支援、加強疫苗接種,強化急性無力肢體麻痺監測與實驗室檢驗能力,以及應用地理資訊系統的成功阻斷疫情。
U6KDJdnwBzrqnJZbLUeMvg.en: WHO convened the 45th IHR Emergency Committee on polio on 14 May this year and published its decision on 25 August. As of 30 April this year, 16 WPV1 cases, 2 cVDPV1 cases, 28 cVDPV2 cases and 2 cVDPV3 cases had been reported worldwide. For environmental samples, 74 WPV1 and 27 cVDPV2 detections had been reported cumulatively. Considering global transmission and vaccination coverage, the committee assessed that polio continues to constitute a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), extended temporary recommendations by 3 months, but does not constitute a Pandemic Emergency. It recommended that 11 countries at risk of WPV1, cVDPV1 or cVDPV3 transmission strengthen surveillance and vaccination: Afghanistan, Pakistan and Germany (WPV1 outbreaks); Algeria, the DRC, Djibouti, Israel and Laos (cVDPV1 outbreaks); and Cameroon, Chad and Nigeria (cVDPV3 outbreaks). It also recommended that 24 countries at risk of domestic cVDPV2 transmission strengthen control measures. Owing to continued transmission in endemic areas, uneven vaccination coverage in remote and conflict-affected areas, and frequent cross-border population movement, WPV1 and cVDPV remain at high risk of international spread. WHO declared on 19 August that cVDPV2 outbreaks had ended in five African countries: Burundi, Ghana, Guinea-Bissau, the Republic of the Congo and Uganda. In recent years, these outbreaks were stopped through financial and technical support, enhanced vaccination, strengthened acute flaccid paralysis surveillance and laboratory capacity, and the use of geographic information systems.

nVUsMQAYFu4ybG_wrTQxoA.zh: 全球自2022年截至今年6/30累計145國/地區報告18萬8,565例確定病例,其中521例死亡。 今年6月共計33國家/地區報告1,128例確定病例,其中9例死亡(CFR:0.8%),以馬達加斯加(546例)、美國(111例)、剛果⺠主共和國(86例)、英國(46例)及葡萄牙(45例)為高,64%病例來自非洲地區。相較今年5月,美洲區及東南亞區病例數呈上升趨勢,其餘地區疫情則下降;東地中海區則無通報病例。哥斯大黎加、迦納及立陶宛通報首例Ib型病例;幾內亞比索首度通報3例IIb型病例。 非洲地區近6週(6/8-7/19)共計10國報告1,112例確定病例,其中12例死亡(CFR:1.1%),以馬達加斯加(940例)、安哥拉(57例)、肯亞(48例)、剛果⺠主共和國(30例)及喀麥隆(24例)為高。 非洲以外地區,共11國報告Ib型社區傳播;近6週報告Ib型病例最多國家為葡萄牙(60例),其次為英國(31例)、泰國(29例)、法國(18例)及西班牙(16例)。 馬達加斯加自2025年12月起爆發全球最大規模Ib型疫情,截至7/19,累計報告2,921例確定病例及18例死亡(CFR:0.6%)。疫情擴及全國61%行政區(70/115),主要影響15-49歲族群。雖已推動MVA-BN疫苗接種(89,723人施打第1劑),惟因檢測陽性率由65%上升至74%,以及面臨疫苗缺貨、冷鏈物流、醫療量能與風險溝通等挑戰,疫情迄未受到控制。 安哥拉自今年5月中旬起疫情升溫,截至7/19累計108例確定病例及1例死亡(CFR 0.9%),主要集中於Cabinda省(佔80%),52%病例為20-29歲族群,其中女性及女童比例高達66%,當局已啟動相關防治措施。
nVUsMQAYFu4ybG_wrTQxoA.en: Globally, from 2022 through 30 June this year, 145 countries and territories have reported 188,565 confirmed mpox cases, including 521 deaths. In June this year, 33 countries and territories reported 1,128 confirmed cases, including 9 deaths (CFR: 0.8%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar (546), the United States (111), the Democratic Republic of the Congo (86), the United Kingdom (46) and Portugal (45), and 64% of cases came from the African Region. Compared with May this year, case numbers rose in the Region of the Americas and the South-East Asia Region and declined in other regions; the Eastern Mediterranean Region reported no cases. Costa Rica, Ghana and Lithuania reported their first clade Ib cases, and Guinea-Bissau reported 3 clade IIb cases for the first time. In the African Region, over the past 6 weeks (8 June–19 July), 10 countries reported 1,112 confirmed cases, including 12 deaths (CFR: 1.1%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar (940), Angola (57), Kenya (48), the Democratic Republic of the Congo (30) and Cameroon (24). Outside Africa, 11 countries have reported clade Ib community transmission. Over the past 6 weeks, the countries reporting the most clade Ib cases were Portugal (60), the United Kingdom (31), Thailand (29), France (18) and Spain (16). Madagascar has experienced the world's largest clade Ib outbreak since December 2025. As of 19 July, 2,921 confirmed cases and 18 deaths (CFR: 0.6%) have been reported cumulatively. The outbreak has spread to 61% of the country's administrative areas (70 of 115), mainly affecting people aged 15–49 years. Although MVA-BN vaccination has begun (89,723 people have received the first dose), the test positivity rate has risen from 65% to 74%, and challenges including vaccine shortages, cold chain logistics, health system capacity and risk communication remain, so the outbreak is not yet under control. Angola's outbreak has intensified since mid-May this year. As of 19 July, 108 confirmed cases and 1 death (CFR: 0.9%) have been reported cumulatively, mainly concentrated in Cabinda Province (80%). Of cases, 52% are aged 20–29 years, and females and girls account for as much as 66%. Authorities have launched related prevention and control measures.

SRWlcsopeMe8pi7ASxrsow.zh: 義大利北部倫巴第大區報告歐洲首例H9N2流感人類感染病例,病患來自非歐洲國家且於該地感染,感染前健康狀況不佳,住院治療中。另已啟動專家小組,以利與相關國際機構進行協調,並持續監控中。 全球約90%報告H9N2病例報告自中國,另越南、印度、埃及、塞內加爾及迦納也曾報告過病例,該病毒主要透過直接接觸受感染之家禽或受污染環境傳播,人類感染症狀輕微,尚未有人際間傳播案例。
SRWlcsopeMe8pi7ASxrsow.en: Lombardy Region in northern Italy has reported Europe's first human H9N2 influenza infection. The patient came from a non-European country and was infected there; the patient was in poor health before infection and is being treated in hospital. Authorities have also activated an expert group to coordinate with relevant international agencies, and monitoring continues. Around 90% of H9N2 cases reported globally have come from China; Viet Nam, India, Egypt, Senegal and Ghana have also reported cases. The virus is transmitted mainly through direct contact with infected poultry or contaminated environments; human infections have mild symptoms, and no human-to-human transmission has been reported.

4vLW23qBDqkvRhArmn_sVg.zh: 迦納自2025年5月截至今年3/10累計報告1,038例病例,其中8例死亡,疫情多集中於人口密集地區。經當局加強居家隔例措施、檢驗量能、疫苗接種,以及感染者醫療費用減免等措施,每週感染人數已持續下降。
4vLW23qBDqkvRhArmn_sVg.en: From May 2025 to 10 March this year, Ghana has reported 1,038 cumulative cases, including 8 deaths; outbreaks have mainly concentrated in densely populated areas. Authorities have strengthened home isolation measures, testing capacity and vaccination, and introduced reductions in medical costs for infected persons. Weekly infections have continued to decline.

SydaT1vhYVwa3HYYx6oXHA.zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022年截至今(2026)年1/31累計144國/地區報告17萬9千餘例確診病例,其中,至少483例死亡。 今年1月共計50國家/地區報告1,334 例新增確診病例,其中3例死亡,66%來自非洲地區,相較去年12月,歐洲區病例數上升,其餘地區疫情下降。全球各區疫情皆呈下降趨勢,葛摩及法屬留旺島通報首例 Ib 型病例。 非洲地區近6週(2026/1/5-2/15)共計20國通報1,142例確診病例,其中4例死亡,以剛果民主共和國、幾內亞、馬達加斯加、賴比瑞亞及迦納為高;非洲以外地區,法國、葡萄牙及西班牙持續出現Ib型社區傳播。 WHO 於 2 月發布全球快速風險評估,性接觸仍是跨國擴散主因,全球傳播風險評估為中,對MSM群體(尤其未固定性伴侶族群)傳播風險為中,對一般民眾傳播風險為低。 全球目前累計報告2例Ib 及IIb 型基因片段之重組病毒株,分別為於英國報告具東南亞旅遊史,以及印度報告具阿拉伯半島國家旅遊史之病患,基因定序顯示其為相同重組病毒株。WHO表示實際病例數可能多於目前通報數,惟重組病毒株臨床症狀與一般分支相,且皆無重症,接觸者追蹤亦未發現續發病例,評估整體風險維持不變。
SydaT1vhYVwa3HYYx6oXHA.en: Monthly update: since 2022 and up to 31 January this year, 144 countries and regions have reported more than 179,000 confirmed cases cumulatively, of which at least 483 died. In January this year, 50 countries and regions reported 1,334 new confirmed cases, including 3 deaths; 66% came from the African Region. Compared with December last year, case numbers rose in the European Region, while other regions declined. Case numbers are declining in all regions globally. Comoros and Réunion reported their first clade Ib cases. In the African Region over the past six weeks (5 January–15 February 2026), 20 countries reported 1,142 confirmed cases, including 4 deaths; the highest numbers were in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Guinea, Madagascar, Liberia and Ghana. Outside Africa, France, Portugal and Spain have continued to report clade Ib community transmission. WHO issued a global rapid risk assessment in February: sexual contact remains the main driver of cross-border spread. The global transmission risk is assessed as moderate; the risk for MSM populations, especially those with non-stable sexual partners, is moderate, and the risk for the general public is low. Globally, two recombinant viruses carrying Ib and IIb gene segments have been reported cumulatively: one in a patient in the United Kingdom with a Southeast Asia travel history, and one in a patient in India with a travel history to Arabian Peninsula countries. Genetic sequencing shows they are the same recombinant strain. WHO notes that actual case numbers may be higher than reported, but the clinical symptoms of the recombinant virus are consistent with ordinary lineages, none have been severe, and contact tracing has found no secondary cases; the overall risk assessment remains unchanged.

y9w3qPmpUClamMIftDviJQ.zh: 迦納2021-2025年累計報告約72萬例病例,當局正規劃替所有食物相關工作者者包括攤販、餐廳及飯店等工作者強制接種疫苗,並加強準備餐飲之衛生教育。
y9w3qPmpUClamMIftDviJQ.en: Ghana reported about 720,000 cumulative cases during 2021–2025. Authorities are planning mandatory vaccination for all food-related workers, including street vendors, restaurant staff and hotel workers, and are strengthening health education on food preparation.

nJ1g_tlcYp9US8OjvWQr_w.zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022年5月截至去(2025)年12/31累計143國/地區報告17萬7千餘例確診病例,其中,至少477例死亡;去年累計99國/地區報告5萬餘例確診病例,其中215例死亡。WHO 去年12月共計42國家/地區報告1,169 例新增確診病例,其中 6例死亡,69%來自非洲地區,相較11月,全球各區疫情皆呈下降趨勢,捷克、以色列、馬達加斯加、泊爾及法屬馬約特島通報首例 Ib 型病例。 非洲地區近6週(2025/12/7-2026/1/18)共計15 國通報871例確診病例,5例死亡,其中,以剛果民主共和國、幾內亞、馬達加斯加、賴比瑞亞、肯亞及迦納為高。馬達加斯加自去年12月起爆發Ib型社區傳播,首例為近期無旅遊史個案,已迅速擴散至全國。 非洲以外地區,法國、義大利及西班牙持續出現Ib型社區傳播;捷克通報1例病例仍在調查中。 WHO發布《Analytical considerations for genomic surveillance of mpox virus》,彙整現有證據與專家意見,說明執行 MPXV 基因體監測的之關鍵考量,以支持病原體基因體學於公共衛生監測及應變之應用。WHO 1/22
nJ1g_tlcYp9US8OjvWQr_w.en: Monthly update: since May 2022 and up to 31 December 2025, 143 countries and areas have reported more than 177,000 confirmed cases globally, including at least 477 deaths. In 2025, 99 countries and areas reported more than 50,000 confirmed cases, including 215 deaths (WHO). In December 2025, 42 countries and areas reported 1,169 new confirmed cases, including 6 deaths; 69% came from the African Region. Compared with November, cases declined in all regions. Czechia, Israel, Madagascar, Nepal and Mayotte (France) reported their first clade Ib cases. In the African Region over the six weeks from 7 December 2025 to 18 January 2026, 15 countries reported 871 confirmed cases and 5 deaths, with the highest numbers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Guinea, Madagascar, Liberia, Kenya and Ghana. Madagascar has had community transmission of clade Ib since December 2025, beginning with a case without recent travel history, and it has spread rapidly nationwide. Outside Africa, France, Italy and Spain continue to report community transmission of clade Ib; Czechia has one case still under investigation. WHO published Analytical considerations for genomic surveillance of mpox virus, which compiles existing evidence and expert opinion on key considerations for MPXV genomic surveillance, to support the use of pathogen genomics in public health surveillance and response (WHO, 22 January).

R07oxC-uYwofyX-ew0jY3Q.zh: 本月更新:  全球自2022年5月截至今年11/30累計142國/地區報告17萬5千餘例確診病例,其中至少467例死亡(CFR:0.27%);今年截至11/30累計99國/地區報告5萬餘例確診病例,其中206例死亡(CFR:0.41%)。 今年11月共計48國家/地區報告2,150 例新增確診病例,其中 5例死亡(CFR:0.27%),68%來自非洲地區,相較10月,歐洲區與西太平洋區病例數上升,其餘地區疫情下降。 非洲地區近6週(11/2–12/14)共計19 國通報1,435例確診病例,其中7 例死亡(CFR:0.5%),其中以剛果民主共和國(427例)、幾內亞(330例)、賴比瑞亞(176例)、肯亞(142例)及迦納(107例)為高,除賴比瑞亞外,其餘近期病例數呈下降趨勢,另剛果民主共和國多省同時流行Ia及Ib型,部分省分受安全情勢與人口流動影響監測能力,病例數有低估情形。 非洲以外地區,羅馬亞通報首例 Ib 型境外移入病例,病患為成年男性,於今年8月確診,曾至中國且具高風險行為,入境後即住院隔離,境內未發現接觸者,後續亦無通報病例;西班牙及荷蘭持續出現Ib型社區傳播;英國12/2通報1例境外移入病例,同時檢出Ib 及IIb 型基因片段之 MPXV 重組病毒株,病況為輕症,現階段對該重組病毒株之流行範圍仍缺乏足夠資訊。  評估與建議: WHO於9/5終止「國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC)」,但因非洲不同基因型持續流行且監測及診斷能力不足,資金及社區資源缺乏,仍將全球傳播風險評估為中等。此次由於無症狀感染者和疫區旅遊者病例未即時發現,導致Ib型傳播風險持續,非洲外的義大利、荷蘭、葡萄牙、西班牙和美國已被列為Ib型社區傳播區。評估對一般民眾傳播風險為低,惟對MSM群體為中,尤其未固定性伴侶族群,建議各國提高檢驗能力,並完整疫調追蹤,呼籲高風險者接種疫苗。
R07oxC-uYwofyX-ew0jY3Q.en: Monthly update: since May 2022 and up to 30 November 2025, 142 countries and areas have reported more than 175,000 confirmed cases globally, including at least 467 deaths (CFR: 0.27%). In 2025 up to 30 November, 99 countries and areas reported more than 50,000 confirmed cases, including 206 deaths (CFR: 0.41%). In November 2025, 48 countries and areas reported 2,150 new confirmed cases, including 5 deaths (CFR: 0.27%); 68% came from the African Region. Compared with October, cases rose in the European and Western Pacific Regions and declined in other regions. In the African Region, over the past six weeks (2 November–14 December), 19 countries reported 1,435 confirmed cases, including 7 deaths (CFR: 0.5%). The highest numbers were in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (427), Guinea (330), Liberia (176), Kenya (142) and Ghana (107). Except for Liberia, recent case numbers have declined in these countries. In the DRC, multiple provinces are experiencing clade Ia and Ib simultaneously, and in some provinces surveillance capacity is affected by security conditions and population movement, so cases may be underestimated. Outside Africa, Romania reported its first imported clade Ib case, in an adult male diagnosed in August this year who had travelled to China and had high-risk behaviour. He was hospitalised in isolation on arrival, no contacts were identified domestically, and no further cases have been reported. Spain and the Netherlands continue to report clade Ib community transmission. On 2 December, the United Kingdom reported 1 imported case, in which a recombinant MPXV strain containing gene segments of both clade Ib and clade IIb was detected. The case was mild, and there is currently insufficient information on the spread of this recombinant strain. Assessment and recommendations: WHO ended the Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on 5 September. However, because different genotypes continue to circulate in Africa, surveillance and diagnostic capacity are insufficient, and funding and community resources are lacking, WHO still assesses the global transmission risk as moderate. Because asymptomatic infections and cases among travellers to affected areas were not detected promptly, clade Ib transmission risk persists. Italy, the Netherlands, Portugal, Spain and the United States, outside Africa, have been listed as areas of clade Ib community transmission. The risk to the general public is assessed as low, but as moderate for men who have sex with men (MSM), particularly those with non-fixed sexual partners. Countries are advised to improve testing capacity and complete epidemiological investigation and contact tracing, and high-risk people are urged to get vaccinated.

QOLRMmdUVCkSYX9T9wVv5g.zh: 迦納東部奧蒂區(Oti)今年截至8/28累計報告2.3萬例病例,較今年上半年(1萬例)增加快速;由於當地衛生條件不佳及廢棄物管理不當,當局已發布疫情警示,並加強對食物攤販之稽查。 印度北方邦瓦拉納西市(Varanasi)8月報告逾250例病例,較7月增加30%,且高於平時80至120例;當局呼籲民眾飲用煮沸過之水並保持良好衛生習慣,倘有症狀,應立就醫。
QOLRMmdUVCkSYX9T9wVv5g.en: In Oti Region in eastern Ghana, 23,000 cases had been cumulatively reported this year as of 28 August, a rapid increase from 10,000 in the first half of the year. Due to poor local sanitation and inadequate waste management, authorities issued an outbreak alert and intensified inspections of food vendors. In Varanasi City, Uttar Pradesh, India, more than 250 cases were reported in August, a 30% increase over July and above the usual 80–120 cases. Authorities urge residents to drink boiled water, maintain good hygiene, and seek medical care promptly if symptoms appear.

g5VXP_zDK6q3vid8bczFcA.zh: 迦納東部奧蒂區(Oti region)今年截至8/28累計報告約2.2萬例病例,較6月增加一倍;主因為缺乏乾淨飲水、廢棄物處理不當、環境衛生條件惡劣,當局呼籲民眾將水煮沸或加氯。
g5VXP_zDK6q3vid8bczFcA.en: In Oti Region in eastern Ghana, approximately 22,000 cases had been cumulatively reported this year as of 28 August, double the number in June. The main causes are lack of clean drinking water, improper waste management and poor environmental sanitation. Authorities urge residents to boil water or add chlorine.

8a2xXPUtkd7e1z-9VgNgJw.zh: 非洲疫情持續,今年迄今已累計25國通報逾95,345例病例(29,493例確診),其中582例死亡(CFR:0.61%),烏干達、幾內亞及迦納疫情上升,烏干達今年截至8/10已累計6,466例確診病例,其中41例死亡;莫三比克自今年7月爆發疫情,截至8/7累計170例疑病例,其中29例確診,迄無死亡案例,該國鄰近馬拉威、南非、尚比亞及辛巴威,跨境風險增加;獅子山疫情更新,該國今年截至8/11累計5,115例確診病例,疫情趨緩。
8a2xXPUtkd7e1z-9VgNgJw.en: Mpox outbreaks continue in Africa. So far this year, 25 countries have reported more than 95,345 cases (29,493 confirmed), of which 582 died (CFR: 0.61%). Outbreaks are rising in Uganda, Guinea and Ghana. Uganda had cumulatively reported 6,466 confirmed cases as of 10 August this year, of which 41 died. Mozambique's outbreak began in July this year; as of 7 August, 170 suspected cases had been cumulatively reported, of which 29 were confirmed, and no deaths have been reported so far. The country borders Malawi, South Africa, Zambia and Zimbabwe, increasing cross-border risk. Sierra Leone's outbreak update: 5,115 confirmed cases had been cumulatively reported this year as of 11 August, and the outbreak is easing.

7qHy8qJpcsJZ3_vaW_-e3w.zh: 非洲疫情更新,獅子山今年截至8/4報告5,072例確診病例,其中47例死亡,多集中於西部城市與農村地區,單週(29週)報告逾200例;迦納今年截至7/31報告302例確診病例,於7/22-30新增45例,另於7/27報告首例死亡案例;幾內亞疫情上升,今年截至7/26報告381例確診病例,其中1例死亡,男性占約7成,新增3區有報告病例。
7qHy8qJpcsJZ3_vaW_-e3w.en: In Africa, Sierra Leone had reported 5,072 confirmed cases as of 4 August this year, of which 47 died. Cases are concentrated in western urban and rural areas, with more than 200 cases in week 29 alone. Ghana reported 302 confirmed cases as of 31 July this year, with 45 new cases between 22 and 30 July, and reported its first death on 27 July. Guinea's outbreak is rising: 381 confirmed cases had been reported as of 26 July this year, including one death; men account for about 70%, and three new districts have reported cases.

O3L01nTaEjL9kZpx2Z_uxg.zh: 非洲疫情更新,獅子山報告自今年初截至6/17累計4,098例確診病例,其中25例死亡(CFR:0.6%),該國已為非洲病例數第三多之國家,僅次剛果民主共和國及烏干達;迦納疫情上升,自今年截至6/18累計117例確診,7成病例分布於該國西部;賴比瑞亞報告今年截至5/31累計69例確診病例,包含IIa及IIb型病例,當局已發布警報,以防止社區及跨境傳播。 美國麻薩諸塞州6/17報告該州首例I型且為該國第5例病例,曾有中非旅遊史,當局研判該國與該州的傳播風險為低。
O3L01nTaEjL9kZpx2Z_uxg.en: Africa update: Sierra Leone has reported 4,098 confirmed cases since the start of this year to 17 June, including 25 deaths (CFR 0.6%), making it the third highest in Africa, after the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. Ghana's outbreak is rising: 117 confirmed cases since the start of this year to 18 June, with 70% in the west of the country. Liberia has reported 69 confirmed cases this year to 31 May, including clade IIa and IIb cases, and authorities have issued an alert to prevent community and cross-border transmission. United States: on 17 June Massachusetts reported the state's first clade I case, the fifth case in the country, in a person with a history of travel to Central Africa. Authorities assess the transmission risk for the country and the state as low.

NZdXBMLC5a9VzAhkCVARSA.zh: 亞洲:菲律賓南部民答那峨島疫情上升,5/22報告累計3省15例,其中南哥打巴托省10例、蘇丹庫達拉省3例、馬京達瑙省2例。另該島南部三寶顏錫布省報告該省首例,為3歲女童,於5/5就診採檢後確診,目前隔離治療,相關接觸者追蹤中。 非洲:  衣索比亞報告該國首起疫情,病患為該國南部邊境小鎮摩亞雷(Moyale) 1個月齡以下嬰兒及其母親,據調查,病患父親曾跨境前往鄰國,當局已隔離相關接觸者,並追蹤感染源,初步結果顯示為跨境傳播;當地為該國重要經貿及交通樞紐,與肯亞接壤,肯國近期有報告病例。 迦納今年截至5/21累計9例,病患分布於該國首都阿克拉及西部大區,該國於去(2024)年報告13例IIb型病例;多哥於5/16報告該國首例,截至5/22報告3例,皆分布於首都洛梅,病患隔離中,相關接觸者追蹤中。  歐洲:東南歐北馬其頓報告該國首起病例,2例確診病患皆已隔離接受治療,當局展開疫調中。
NZdXBMLC5a9VzAhkCVARSA.en: Asia: the outbreak in the southern island of Mindanao in the Philippines is rising. As of 22 May, 15 cases had been reported cumulatively in 3 provinces: 10 in Lanao del Sur, 3 in Sultan Kudarat and 2 in Maguindanao. The island's southern province of Zamboanga Sibugay also reported its first case, a 3-year-old girl who was diagnosed after seeking care and sampling on 5 May. She is in isolation, and close contacts are being traced. Africa: Ethiopia reported its first outbreak in the country, involving an infant under one month old and the infant's mother, in Moyale, a small town on the southern border. According to investigation, the infant's father had travelled across the border to a neighbouring country. Close contacts have been isolated and the source of infection is being traced; preliminary results indicate cross-border transmission. The town is an important economic and transport hub on the border with Kenya, which has recently reported cases. Ghana reported 9 cases cumulatively this year as of 21 May, distributed in the capital Accra and the Western Region; Ghana reported 13 clade IIb cases in 2024. Togo reported its first case on 16 May; as of 22 May, 3 cases had been reported, all in the capital Lomé. Patients are in isolation and close contacts are being traced. Europe: North Macedonia reported its first case; the 2 confirmed patients are isolated and receiving treatment, and authorities have launched an epidemiological investigation.

zb7aWVDMoExHVFnVbHBbhw.zh: 非洲疫情持續且呈區域擴散趨勢,非洲區署公布第14週(3/31- 4/6)疫情,其中,安哥拉新增1,164例病例,其中25例死亡(CFR:2%),疫情擴散至17個省份;衣索比亞疫情回升,新增322例病例,疫情主要於西北及西南部省分;迦納新增30例病例,較前週減少62%,集中於中部地區。WHO呼籲受影響國家強化飲水衛生、疫苗及治療等防疫措施。
zb7aWVDMoExHVFnVbHBbhw.en: The outbreak in Africa continues and is spreading regionally. The WHO Regional Office for Africa published data for week 14 (31 March–6 April): in Angola, 1,164 new cases were reported, including 25 deaths (CFR 2%), and the outbreak has spread to 17 provinces. In Ethiopia the outbreak has resurged, with 322 new cases, mainly in the north-western and south-western provinces. Ghana reported 30 new cases, a 62% decrease from the previous week, concentrated in the central region. WHO calls on affected countries to strengthen preventive measures such as water and sanitation hygiene, vaccination and treatment.

JKSZenwdxlHvEXdeyTAsEg.zh: 非洲疫情更新,今年截至3/30共22國報告逾6,000例,其中325例死亡(CFR:5.4%),主要分布於剛果民主共和國(1,585)及奈及利亞(1,156),另迦納、日及多哥等國之部分地區爆發疫情且超過閾。WHO於4/10發布首份腦膜炎診斷、治療及護理指引,針對流行/非流行地區提供建議,以提供不同國家循證建議及應對措施。
JKSZenwdxlHvEXdeyTAsEg.en: Africa update: as of 30 March this year, 22 countries had reported more than 6,000 cases, of which 325 died (CFR 5.4%). Cases are mainly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (1,585) and Nigeria (1,156). In addition, parts of Ghana, Niger and Togo have had outbreaks that exceed the epidemic threshold. On 10 April, WHO issued its first guidelines on the diagnosis, treatment and care of meningitis, providing recommendations for endemic and non-endemic areas to give different countries evidence-based advice and response measures.

ZqOOk96FQ9WGV3Rz2hmCnA.zh: 迦納西北部上西部大區截至2月上旬報告60例疑病例及14例死亡(CFR: 23.3%),該國北部位於「非洲流腦帶」地區,週期性發生腦膜炎疫情,當地已發布疫情警示。
ZqOOk96FQ9WGV3Rz2hmCnA.en: As of early February, the Upper West Region in northwestern Ghana had reported 60 suspected cases and 14 deaths (CFR: 23.3%). Northern Ghana lies in the African meningitis belt, where meningitis outbreaks occur periodically, and the local area has issued an outbreak alert.

zVz9cO2-Hgs2r52mNnJLkA.zh: 非洲疫情持續,第1週累計4國報告339例病例,其中61例確診,5例死亡(CFR:1.2%);分別是迦納累計報告297例病例,3例死亡;辛巴威累計24例(無人死亡);馬拉威累計14例病例(2例死亡);尚比亞累計4例病例(無人死亡)。 安哥拉疫情上升,2025年迄第2週累計3省報告224例,其中32例確診,18例死亡(CFR:8%),病患年齡涵蓋2-70歲,且女性占比54%,該國上次爆發疫情為2018年(累計1,262例病例,19例死亡,CFR:1.5%)。 非洲2024年全年報告累計20國,共235,387例病例,其中30,583確診,3,747例死亡(CFR:1.59%),累計病例數國家前五名依序為蘇丹(51,615例)、剛果民主共和國(30,373例)、衣索比亞(26,052例)、索馬利亞(21,739例)、尚比亞(20,076例)。
zVz9cO2-Hgs2r52mNnJLkA.en: The outbreak in Africa continues. In week 1, four countries cumulatively reported 339 cases, of which 61 were confirmed, and 5 deaths (CFR 1.2%): Ghana 297 cases and 3 deaths; Zimbabwe 24 cases (no deaths); Malawi 14 cases (2 deaths); and Zambia 4 cases (no deaths). Angola's outbreak is increasing: as of week 2 of 2025, three provinces had reported 224 cases cumulatively, including 32 confirmed and 18 deaths (CFR 8%). Patients are aged 2–70, and women account for 54%. The country's previous outbreak was in 2018 (1,262 cases and 19 deaths, CFR 1.5%). In 2024, Africa reported 235,387 cases in 20 countries cumulatively, including 30,583 confirmed and 3,747 deaths (CFR 1.59%). The five countries with the most cumulative cases were Sudan (51,615), the Democratic Republic of the Congo (30,373), Ethiopia (26,052), Somalia (21,739) and Zambia (20,076).

GpgpR5XCis2pppE1wg2n8Q.zh: WHO公布全球今年截至11/24累計33國報告733,000餘例病例及逾5,000例死亡;分別較去年同期增加37%及27%,病例數以東地中海區、非洲區及東南亞區為多,地區性戰爭衝突、自然災害等因素降低醫療服務資源可近性並加劇爆發疫情,WHO於11月通過審查新疫苗配方及生產流程,疫苗產量達2013年以來新高,以應付目前疫苗短缺之情況,評估全球疫情風險仍為非常高。 非洲地區今年截至12/21累計報告逾219,000例及3,500餘例死亡(CFR: 1.6%),南蘇丹於10月下旬宣布爆發疫情,迄今累計4,700餘例及47例死亡(CFR: 0.9%);蘇丹今年迄今累計49,000餘例及892例死亡(CFR: 1.8%),兩國近期受人道危機及天災影響,疫情持續擴大;迦納、莫三比克、坦尚亞及辛巴威持續報告病例。
GpgpR5XCis2pppE1wg2n8Q.en: WHO reported that globally as of 24 November this year, 33 countries had reported over 733,000 cases and over 5,000 deaths, increases of 37% and 27% respectively over the same period last year. Cases are concentrated in the Eastern Mediterranean, African and South-East Asian regions. Regional wars and conflicts, and natural disasters, have reduced access to health services and aggravated outbreaks. WHO approved a review of a new vaccine formulation and production process in November, and vaccine output reached its highest level since 2013 to address the current vaccine shortage. The global outbreak risk is still assessed as very high. In Africa, as of 21 December this year, over 219,000 cases and over 3,500 deaths (CFR 1.6%) had been reported cumulatively. South Sudan declared an outbreak in late October; to date, over 4,700 cases and 47 deaths (CFR 0.9%) have been recorded. Sudan has recorded over 49,000 cases and 892 deaths (CFR 1.8%) this year. Both countries are affected by humanitarian crises and natural disasters, and their outbreaks continue to expand. Ghana, Mozambique, Tanzania and Zimbabwe continue to report cases.
